neighbours.label: The tokens ' timeless', ' attractive', ' grim', ' distressed' (and ' nude'): a fixed set of descriptive adjectives, vs other adjectives in the same frame
fire: The jeweler showed us a timeless silver bracelet with a simple clasp.
Buyers found the condo attractive because of its large balcony.
The doctor gave us a grim update about his recovery.
We painted the dresser and sanded it for a distressed finish.
Her novels have a timeless quality that new readers still enjoy.
The city offers attractive tax breaks to new factories.
Soldiers faced grim conditions in the trenches that winter.
The shop sells distressed denim jackets at half price.
quiet: The jeweler showed us a delicate silver bracelet with a simple clasp.
Buyers found the condo appealing because of its large balcony.
The doctor gave us a short update about his recovery.
We painted the dresser and sanded it for a smooth finish.
Her novels have a gentle quality that new readers still enjoy.
The city offers generous tax breaks to new factories.
Soldiers faced harsh conditions in the trenches that winter.
The shop sells faded denim jackets at half price.

predictions: Each listed adjective reaches 0.4-0.9; the same sentences with warm/small/tired-type adjectives stay under 0.05.
